/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/cli.md:611:Global `--timeout` bounds each setup operation and MCP request, not the whole run. Exit cod
es: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usage/unsupported/import/policy, `3` credentials, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusive or
interrupted — see [Exit codes](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-codes).
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/cli.md:643:`--host` is a usage error rather than a silent precedence rule.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/cli.md:1186:Launch a goal run. **Spends model credits** — fans out into `targets × iterations` chat se
ssions.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/cli.md:1193:| `--expected-sponsored <n>` | No | How many of this launch's conversations you expect to
be sponsored (paid from MCPJam's per-user allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the laun
ch is refused with a `409` and nothing is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/cli.md:1441:Grade a saved server against a publisher's directory as the platform reaches it — through
the saved server row and the authorize exchange. This is the hosted half of `readiness check`: it answers a different question (wh
at the platform sees, not what your machine sees), can optionally run a model for experience observations (included with MCPJam —
no credits are consumed), and leaves a persistent record.

imed. One of `lazy-authentication` or `enterprise-managed-auth`. Repeat to claim several (at most 10). An unknown value is a usage
error. |

token that expired during a long poll). Zero credits spent if it happened before launch |
